evidence: Labeled Kernel and adds `btck_chainstate_manager_set_clock_time` in `src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.h` alongside kernel tests.
rationale: Adds an instance-scoped clock API to the kernel to allow library applications to run validation logic deterministically without depending on the system clock or global state. Removing global system clock dependencies from kernel code is core progress toward making validation safely usable as a standalone library across concurrent instances.
